controls.name: scope-ignores-graph
controls.why: Other graph nodes must not enter this walk.

controls.name: absent-seed-admitted
controls.why: Membership comes from the selected node table.

controls.name: repeated-seeds-count-twice
controls.why: Repeated valid IDs have one restart share.

controls.name: stored-multiplicity-ignored
controls.why: Stored keyed multiplicity changes outgoing slots.

controls.name: excluded-edge-kept
controls.why: Eligible edges determine numerator and divisor alike.

controls.name: zero-weight-reverse-enabled
controls.find:
let r=if keep && rev && w>0real && e.dst==u {copies(Hop{dst:e.src,weight:w},mult(e))}else{seq![]};
  f+r+tail
controls.replace:
let r=if keep && rev && e.dst==u {copies(Hop{dst:e.src,weight:w},mult(e))}else{seq![]};
  f+r+tail
controls.why: Weight zero disables reverse traversal.

controls.name: divisor-added-one
controls.why: Divisor is derived eligible slot count.

controls.name: alpha-not-applied-to-hop
controls.why: Follow-edge probability scales each transfer.

controls.name: dangling-score-discarded
controls.why: A zero degree sends its score to restart.

controls.name: restart-drops-dangling
controls.why: Dangling score returns to distinct seeds.

controls.name: initial-share-not-normalized
controls.find: pub open spec fn initial(c:Context)->Seq<real> {seed_add(zeros(c.nodes.len()),c.nodes,c.seeds,1real/(c.seeds.len() as real))}
controls.why: Initial share divides by distinct valid seed count.

controls.name: reverse-weight-ignored
controls.why: Reverse contribution scales independently of divisor.

controls.name: stop-counts-zero-nodes
controls.why: Threshold counts nonzero holders.

controls.name: stop-tolerance-ignored
controls.why: Tolerance materially decides early stop.

controls.name: stop-is-nonstrict
controls.why: Zero change does not pass zero strict tolerance.

controls.name: stopped-step-loses-new-scores
controls.why: Final iteration installs its new scores.

controls.name: decimal-key-too-coarse
controls.why: Above-zero twelve-decimal bucket stays distinct.

controls.name: tie-id-order-reversed

controls.name: zero-rows-not-sparse

controls.name: producer-cap-ignored

controls.name: zero-completion-removed

controls.name: zeros-sorted-with-scored
controls.why: Fast completion appends zeros after ranked rows.

controls.name: cap-precedes-explicit-top
controls.why: Positive caller top remains the reader limit.

controls.name: empty-exclusion-does-not-lift-cap
